text: The Trump administration will announce new fuel-economy standards, rolling back Biden-era rules that required ~50 mpg efficiency by 2031. Executives from Ford, GM, and Stellantis are attending. Oil-industry groups lobbied for the reversal, arguing the prior standards implicitly pushed a long-term shift toward EVs.

meta.note: Represents a deliberate directional reversal in national energy + automotive strategy; rewrites long-term national industrial rules.
